snippet.title: Evercursed: Act I - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Official Announcement Trailer for Evercursed: Act I, an upcoming indie horror RPG releasing in 2026 that was heavily inspired by RPG Maker horror classics such as Mad Father, Witch's House and IB.

Evercursed is a narrative-driven, atmospheric horror experience that delves into the world of sleep paralysis, and the demons that lurk within it. Step into Amelia's haunting nightmares, where the line between dreams and reality is blurred.

Built in Unity.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4756450/Evercursed_Act_I/

Developer: Silversun Games
X: https://x.com/SilversunGames

#EvercursedActI #indiehorror #horrorgame #storyrich
